requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, with 12+ years' of experience in network engineering, systems validation, customer engineering, or network operations.

Experience with scalable data center architectures, including leaf-spine topologies, routing underlays, network overlays, redundancy, high availability, convergence, capacity planning, and failure-domain design.
Applied experience leading solution-level validation, design qualification, or deployment-readiness initiatives for complex data center environments.
Experience with network automation, including automated provisioning, configuration validation, test execution, telemetry collection, and operational workflow integration.
Experience with lab instrumentation, traffic generators, packet-capture tools, network test platforms, and performance-analysis tools.
Proven ability to solve complex, multi-layer issues spanning hardware, software, protocols, optics, automation, and system-level interactions.
Strong technical leadership, multi-functional collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear risks and actionable recommendations.
Experience supporting cloud infrastructure or hyperscale cloud customers, with proficiency in IPv4/IPv6, Layer2 switching/design, Layer3 routing protocols, and network optics.
Familiarity with Cisco network platforms, automation, and telemetry systems, complemented by strong technical writing and customer-facing presentation skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead across organizational boundaries and global time zones, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and operational clarity.
